normal_release_rule: Only ordered, unapplied schema migrations that pass the safety planner may run in the standard release lane.
backfill_rule: Backfill-class work never runs through the standard migration apply command and requires the measured resumable backfill lane.
edited_applied_migration_rule: Any modification, deletion, or rename of a migration present at the deployed production SHA fails release closed.
production_ledger_rule: Applied production migration names must be an exact ordered prefix of the repository migration inventory.
unapplied_rule: Wrangler's remote unapplied list must equal the repository suffix after the applied production prefix.
